propositions: autodeploy.sh uses a single global deployed-sha marker to track completion for two independent components (review-bot and mcp), causing redeploy of a completed component when the other component exits early
a single shared deploy-backoff file throttles both components, so an mcp failure prevents bot deployment and vice versa on subsequent ticks
a component skipped by backoff with pending changes is recorded as deployed at footer, losing the pending delta permanently on next tick
mcp completion marker and backoff state must be separated from bot state while preserving global deployed-sha role for tick-level idempotency and existing observability.sh metric counting
completion markers must be written per-component at deployment time and at footer only for no-op components, with incompleteness flags preventing false completion during backoff skips
observability.sh depends on AUTODEPLOY_ERROR marker count for deploy_errors metric and must continue to receive it from both bot and mcp failures
